name: library-webapp

dependencies.name: library-api
dependencies.description: Searches the book-lookup, browses/filters the catalog, adds/removes books, and updates the caller's own read status and rating.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the member in via Thunder (OIDC + PKCE) and carries the resulting token to library-api.

description: The single-page app members use to sign in, browse the shared catalog, search and add books (via lookup or manual fallback), and mark books read/rate them for themselves. Talks only to library-api — it holds no book data and never calls the book-lookup provider directly.
